sources.title: Bekenstein bounds in de Sitter and flat space
sources.supports: Sec 2 D-bound and SdS entropy; Sec 3 dilute spherical entropy bound proportional to gravitational radius times cosmological horizon radius.
sources.notation: Paper uses G=hbar=c=1 and sometimes gravitational radius means the equivalent BH horizon. Here r_g always means 2GM/c^2; beyond dilute limit these are different.

sources.title: Emergent Gravity and the Dark Universe
sources.supports: Eq 4.28 proposed mass entropy removal, 4.29 postulated bulk entropy; Eq 7.40 spherical integrated force estimate, Eq 7.43-44 point-source acceleration and BTFR; 7.2 includes hot gas.
sources.notation: Its a0=c^2/L differs from project a0=alpha*c^2/L. Its aM=a0/6 is compared to project a0. Paper assumptions and entropy hypotheses are not established GR identities.

sources.title: Particle Creation by Black Holes
sources.supports: Thermal emission at surface-gravity temperature; massive-species emission becomes significant when temperature approaches rest energy. Used for Schwarzschild semiclassical energy-scale diagnostic, not a greybody emission calculation.

sources.actual_version: astro-ph/0107135v2, 19 Jul 2001; PDF has later draft-template date
sources.title: M33: A Galaxy with No Supermassive Black Hole
sources.supports: Historical stellar-dynamical central mass upper bound 1500 solar masses, best fit zero. Does not exclude small BHs or establish an updated 2026 limit.
sources.authors_note: Actual PDF lists Gebhardt, Lauer, Kormendy and collaborators; do not confuse with a different M33 paper by Merritt/Ferrarese/Joseph.
